Pathweft internal preview source integration

QuickLook revision: 2ec219aa18416c6e3b89d6aad3d82d10610f917f
https://github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook/tree/2ec219aa18416c6e3b89d6aad3d82d10610f917f
Copyright (c) 2017-2026 QL-Win Contributors

Selected source files and SHA256 values: source-manifest.json.
Unmodified inspection sources: original/ (plain .cs.txt, not compiled).
Adapted, compiled source: Preview/IViewer.cs, Preview/PreviewSession.cs,
Preview/PreviewModules.cs, Preview/BuiltinViewer.cs, Preview/MarkdownContent.cs,
and the specialist viewers/inspectors under Preview/ listed in docs/PREVIEW-S13.md.

IViewer/ContextObject: prepare/view/cleanup lifecycle and per-viewer context.
TextViewer/Plugin.cs: bounded text/binary detection and low-priority text choice.
MarkdownViewer/Plugin.cs: Markdown extension inventory, priority/selection and cleanup.
MarkdownPanel.cs: selected-content -> formatted-view flow; the browser/template,
script resources and network/file resource bridge are replaced with native WPF.
ImageViewer/ArchiveViewer/FontViewer Plugin.cs: selected format and lifecycle
contracts; existing File Labs WPF/Windows renderers serve the bounded inventory.
Donor scope is selective; see docs/PREVIEW-MODULES.md for exact included formats.

S13 imports selected source for CsvViewer, DbViewer, MailViewer, CertViewer,
AppViewer, ThumbnailViewer, MediaInfoViewer, BinaryViewer, ELFViewer, DumpViewer,
PrefetchViewer, ChmViewer, CLSIDViewer and OfficeViewer. Their original source
and hashes are preserved beside the earlier imports. Pathweft adapts the format,
inspection and lifecycle boundaries to its existing WPF/HTML/native host; donor
export/edit functions, unrestricted browsers, HexEditor, automatic unblocking,
standalone services and plugin downloading are not imported. Office uses a
qualified installed Windows preview handler inside the existing PreviewHost.
Exact separately licensed parser sources/packages/notices and native MediaInfo
are recorded under vendor/Specialists and included in corresponding sources.

The selected source files carry GPL-3.0-or-later headers, including IViewer.cs,
despite the directory-level Common MIT license. Preserve both notices. The
combined derived application is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later, with the
original File Labs MIT license and attribution preserved. Full GPL text is in
COPYING-GPL-3.0.txt. The public Pathweft repository contains the adapted source,
build scripts, dependency pins and original reference text; S6 must include the
matching complete corresponding source with its versioned binary distribution.

No standalone QuickLook process, installer, global input hook, tray, updater,
plugin downloads, reflection discovery or legacy .NET Framework host is used.
